name: All Stone To Tools
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Scar_
description:
Are you ever in a cave, and your tools break, but you only have a crafting table, some sticks, and a bit of andesite? Well now you can turn that andesite into a stone pickaxe.

Made by TaleTellers

Feel free to use in a modpack.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
